page: OVHcloud b3-512 is a General Purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The server runs on a KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate exceptional multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU scores all ranking in the top 10% tier. Memory performance is also strong, with cached small-block read bandwidth reaching the top 10% tier and large-block read/write bandwidth in the top 25% tier. However, single-threaded performance is more moderate, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded compression/decompression tasks falling into the middle 50% average tier.

While the server excels at parallel processing tasks like software compilation, ray tracing, and Redis SET operations, it exhibits limitations in large-scale LLM text generation, where text generation for a 70B model falls into the bottom 10% tier. The 400 GB local NVMe SSD provides fast storage but may be a capacity constraint for data-heavy workloads. This hardware profile offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded workloads, making it effective for parallel computing, database operations, static web serving, and medium-scale prompt processing.
